question: LOT별 불량률을 계산해서 보여줘

SELECT S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, AVG(L.QTY) AS AVERAGE_QTY

pred_sql:
SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, L.TRACKOUTTIME AS TRACK_OUT_TIME, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME
FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = PD.SITEID AND L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID

ORDER BY L.LOTID

gold_sql: SELECT E.EQUIPMENTNAME, AVG(L.QTY) AS 평균수량 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID AND L.SITEID = E.SITEID GROUP BY E.EQUIPMENTNAME
pred_sql: SELECT E.EQUIPMENTNAME, AVG(L.QTY) AS AVERAGE_QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID AND L.SITEID = E.SITEID GROUP BY E.EQUIPMENTNAME
description: 설비명별 LOT 평균 수량을 조회합니다.

question: 작업지시명별 LOT 평균 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT O.PRODUCTORDERNAME, AVG(L.QTY) AS 평균수량 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTORDERID = O.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = O.SITEID GROUP BY O.PRODUCTORDERNAME
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 10 PO.PRODUCTORDERID AS ORDERID, PO.PRODUCTORDERNAME AS PRODUCTORDERNAME, AVG(L.QTY) AS AVERAGE_LOT_QTY FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER PO WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.SITEID = L.SITEID AND (PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID IS NULL OR PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID) WHERE PO.STATE IN ('RELEASED', 'PRODUCTION') GROUP BY PO.PRODUCTORDERID, PO.PRODUCTORDERNAME ORDER BY AVERAGE_LOT_QTY DESC
description: 작업지시명 (PRODUCTORDERNAME) 별 LOT 평균 수량 조회

question: 고객별 작업지시 건수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT CUSTOMERID, COUNT(*) AS 작업지시수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CUSTOMERID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMERID

question: 제품명별 작업지시 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, COUNT(*) AS 작업지시수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = P.SITEID GROUP BY P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS 제품명, COUNT(PO.PRODUCTORDERID) AS 작업지시개수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER PO WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.SITEID = PD.SITEID AND PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID GROUP BY PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME ORDER BY 제품명

question: 고객별 월별 작업지시 건수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT O.CUSTOMERID, YEAR(O.REQUESTTIME) AS 연도, MONTH(O.REQUESTTIME) AS 월, COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE O.CUSTOMERID IS NOT NULL AND O.REQUESTTIME >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND O.REQUESTTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY O.CUSTOMERID, YEAR(O.REQUESTTIME), MONTH(O.REQUESTTIME) ORDER BY O.CUSTOMERID, 연도, 월
pred_sql: SELECT YEAR(REQUESTTIME) AS 연도, MONTH(REQUESTTIME) AS 월, COUNT(*) AS 고객별_월별작업지시건수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE REQUESTTIME >= DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) AND REQUESTTIME < DATEADD(year, 0, GETDATE()) GROUP BY YEAR(REQUESTTIME), MONTH(REQUESTTIME)
description: 지난 1 년 간의 작업지시를 기준으로 연도와 월을 추출하여 고객별 (작업지시) 건수를 집계한 쿼리입니다.

question: 품목 구분명별 LOT 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT C.PRODUCTCLASSNAME, COUNT(*) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PRODUCTCLASS C WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTCLASSID = C.PRODUCTCLASSID AND L.SITEID = C.SITEID GROUP BY C.PRODUCTCLASSNAME
pred_sql: SELECT PRODUCTCLASSID, COUNT(*) AS LOT_COUNT FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY PRODUCTCLASSID ORDER BY LOT_COUNT DESC

question: 공정 정의명별 공정 노드 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT D.PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME, COUNT(*) AS 노드수 FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE N WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PROCESSDEFINITION D WITH (NOLOCK) ON N.PROCESSDEFINITIONID = D.PROCESSDEFINITIONID AND N.SITEID = D.SITEID GROUP BY D.PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME
pred_sql: SELECT PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME AS 프로세스정의명, COUNT(PROCESSNODEID) AS 노드개수 FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME ORDER BY PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME
description: 공정 정의별 공정 노드 개수를 집계하여 조회합니다.

question: 공정 세그먼트명별 공정 노드 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, COUNT(*) AS 노드수 FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE N WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH (NOLOCK) ON N.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND N.SITEID = S.SITEID GROUP BY S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME
pred_sql: SELECT S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME AS 세그먼트명, COUNT(N.PROCESSNODEID) AS 노드개수 FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE N WITH(NOLOCK), CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE N.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND N.SITEID = S.SITEID GROUP BY S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME

question: 배치 상태별 총 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT STATE, SUM(QTY) AS 총수량 FROM CIM_BATCH WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY STATE

question: 자재명별 자재 LOT 평균 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, AVG(ML.QTY) AS 평균수량 FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH (NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID GROUP BY MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME
pred_sql: SELECT MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME AS 자재명, AVG(ML.QTY) AS 평균수량 FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH(NOLOCK) ON ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID AND ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID GROUP BY MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME
description: 자재명별 자재 LOT 평균 수량을 조회합니다.

question: 자재명별 자재 LOT 수량 합계를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, SUM(ML.QTY) AS 수량합계 FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH (NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID GROUP BY MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME
pred_sql: SELECT MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME AS 자재명, SUM(ML.QTY) AS 총수량 FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH(NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID GROUP BY MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, MD.SITEID ORDER BY SUM(ML.QTY) DESC
description: 자재 정의 테이블과 자재 LOT 테이블을 JOIN하여 각 자재별 현재 수량 합계를 조회합니다.

question: 공정 세그먼트별 손실 수량 합계를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.PROCESSSEGMENTID, SUM(L.LOSSQTY) AS 손실수량합계 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.PROCESSSEGMENTID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY L.PROCESSSEGMENTID
pred_sql: SELECT S.PROCESSSEGMENTID, S.SITEID, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME AS SEGMENT_NAME, SUM(L.LOSSQTY) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.PROCESSSEGMENTID = L.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND S.SITEID = L.SITEID GROUP BY S.PROCESSSEGMENTID, S.SITEID, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME
description: 공정 세그먼트별 손실 수량 (LOSSQTY) 합계를 조회합니다.

question: 배치에 연결된 LOT과 배치 상태를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.LOTID, B.BATCHNAME, B.STATE, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL R WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_BATCH B WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.BATCHID = B.BATCHID AND R.SITEID = B.SITEID
pred_sql:
SELECT B.BATCHID, B.SITEID, B.STATE AS BATCH_STATE, L.LOTNAME, L.LOTID, L.QTY AS LOT_QTY
FROM CIM_BATCH B WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL REL WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.BATCHID = REL.BATCHID AND B.SITEID = REL.SITEID
JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) ON REL.LOTID = L.LOTID AND REL.SITEID = L.SITEID
WHERE 1=1
description: 배치 (CIM_BATCH) 와 배치 내의 LOT 들을 연결하여, 배치 상태와 각 LOT 의 이름, ID, 수량을 조회합니다. 배치 테이블에는 LOTID 가 없으므로 CIM_LOTBATCHREL 을 중간 관계 테이블로 사용하여 JOIN 합니다.

question: 지연 작업지시의 제품명과 계획 종료일을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 O.PRODUCTORDERID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, O.SCHEDULEENDTIME, O.DELAYFLAG FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE O.DELAYFLAG = 'Y'
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 1000 P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, SCHEDULEENDTIME AS PLANNED_END_DATE FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE DELAYFLAG = 'Y' AND (P.SITEID IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID))
description: 지연된 작업지시(CIM_PRODUCTORDER.DELAYFLAG='Y')의 제품명과 계획 종료일을 조회합니다. 사이트 ID 가 NULL 인 경우 또는 해당 PRODUCTDEFINITION 이 존재하는 경우만 필터링하며, 지연 여부 코드값은 'Y'로 설정했습니다.

question: 자재 분류명과 자재명 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 M.MATERIALDEFINITIONID, C.MATERIALCLASSNAME, M.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME FROM CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION M WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALCLASS C WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.MATERIALCLASSID = C.MATERIALCLASSID AND M.SITEID = C.SITEID
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 1000 MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME AS 자재분류명, ML.MATERIALLOTNAME AS 자재명 FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH(NOLOCK) ON ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID AND ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID
description: 자재 분류명과 자재명을 조회합니다.

question: LOT별 소비 자재 수량 합계를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT R.LOTID, SUM(R.QTY) AS 소비수량합계 FROM CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL R WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY R.LOTID
pred_sql: SELECT L.LOTID, SUM(RL.QTY) AS TOTAL_CONSUMED_QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL RL WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = RL.LOTID GROUP BY L.LOTID
description: 각 LOT ID 별 소비된 자재 수량 (CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL.QTY) 을 합산하여 조회합니다.

question: 확정 작업지시의 제품명과 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 O.PRODUCTORDERID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, O.QTY, O.FIRMFLAG FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE O.FIRMFLAG = 'Y'
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 1000 O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AS PRODUCTDEFINITION_ID, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, O.QTY AS ORDER_QTY FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON O.SITEID = PD.SITEID AND O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID WHERE O.FIRMFLAG = 'Y'
description: 확정된 작업지시 (FIRMFLAG='Y') 의 제품명 및 수량을 조회합니다.

question: 설비 알람 ID와 설비 분류명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 E.EQUIPMENTID, E.ALARMID, C.EQUIPMENTCLASSNAME FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENTCLASS C WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.EQUIPMENTCLASSID = C.EQUIPMENTCLASSID AND E.SITEID = C.SITEID WHERE E.ALARMID IS NOT NULL AND E.ALARMID <> ''

question: 공정 정의별 기본 라우팅 수를 보여줘

question: 일별 작업지시 실적 시작 건수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT CONVERT(date, O.STARTTIME) AS 시작일자, COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE O.STARTTIME >= DATEADD(day, -30, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND O.STARTTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CONVERT(date, O.STARTTIME) ORDER BY 시작일자

question: 월별 TrackOut 건수를 보여줘

question: 최근 7일 일별 TrackIn 건수를 보여줘

pred_sql: SELECT TOP 1000 YEAR(REQUESTTIME) AS MONTH, COUNT(PRODUCTORDERID) AS COMPLETED_COUNT FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE STATE = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY YEAR(REQUESTTIME)
description: 작업지시 완료 건수를 월별 (요청 시간 기준 연도) 로 집계한 결과입니다.

question: 사이트별 일별 TrackIn 건수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.SITEID, CONVERT(date, L.TRACKINTIME) AS 작업일자, COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(day, -14, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY L.SITEID, CONVERT(date, L.TRACKINTIME) ORDER BY L.SITEID, 작업일자
pred_sql: SELECT SITEID, TRACKINTIME AS DATE, COUNT(*) AS TRACKIN_COUNT FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) GROUP BY SITEID, TRACKINTIME ORDER BY SITEID, TRACKINTIME
description: 사이트별 날짜 (TrackIn 시간) 에 따른 TrackIn 건수 집계

question: 배치명과 LOT 제품명을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 B.BATCHNAME, L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL R WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_BATCH B WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.BATCHID = B.BATCHID AND R.SITEID = B.SITEID INNER JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.LOTID = L.LOTID AND R.SITEID = L.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID
pred_sql: SELECT B.BATCHNAME AS 배치명, L.LOTNAME AS LOT제품명 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL REL WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = REL.LOTID AND L.SITEID = REL.SITEID JOIN CIM_BATCH B WITH(NOLOCK) ON REL.BATCHID = B.BATCHID AND B.SITEID = REL.SITEID
description: 배치명과 LOT 제품명을 조회합니다.

question: 작업지시·제품명·LOT 수량을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 O.PRODUCTORDERID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.LOTID, L.QTY, L.STATE FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTORDERID = O.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = O.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = P.SITEID
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PO.PRODUCTORDERID AS ORDER_ID, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, L.LOTNAME AS LOT_NAME, L.QTY AS LOT_QTY FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER PO WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.SITEID = L.SITEID AND PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PO.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND PO.SITEID = PD.SITEID WHERE (PO.STATE IN ('RELEASED', 'PRODUCTION') OR ISNULL(PO.STATE, '') <> '' ) ORDER BY L.LOTFINISHEDTIME DESC
description: 작업지시(PRODUCTORDER), 제품명(PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME), LOT 수량(QTY)을 조회합니다. 작업지시는 확정 또는 생산 상태여야 하며, 제품명과 LOT명은 JOIN 을 통해 가져옵니다.

question: LOT 자재 소비 내역에 자재명과 공정명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.LOTID, MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL R WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.MATERIALLOTID = ML.MATERIALLOTID AND R.SITEID = ML.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH (NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND R.SITEID = S.SITEID
pred_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTID, MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME AS MATERIAL_NAME, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME AS PROCESS_SEGMENT_NAME
FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL REL WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.LOTID = REL.LOTID AND L.SITEID = REL.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH(NOLOCK) ON REL.MATERIALLOTID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND REL.SITEID = MD.SITEID
LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH(NOLOCK) ON REL.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND REL.SITEID = S.SITEID
description: 자재 LOT 의 소비 내역을 조회하며, 자재 정의 테이블을 통해 자재명과 공정 세그먼트 테이블을 통해 공정명을 JOIN 하여 표시합니다.

question: TrackIn 건수 상위 5개 설비와 설비명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 5 L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME, COUNT(*) AS TrackIn건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID AND L.SITEID = E.SITEID WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(month, -6, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY L.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME ORDER BY TrackIn건수 DESC
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 5 E.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME AS 설비명, COUNT(L.TRACKINTIME) AS TrackIn_건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = E.SITEID AND L.EQUIPMENTID = E.EQUIPMENTID WHERE L.STATE <> 'H' GROUP BY E.EQUIPMENTID, E.EQUIPMENTNAME ORDER BY TrackIn_건수 DESC
description: 설비별 작업 시작 건수를 집계하여 상위 5 개를 조회합니다.

question: 전체 LOT 평균 수량 이상인 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.QTY FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.QTY >= (SELECT AVG(QTY) FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE QTY IS NOT NULL)
pred_sql:
SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTID, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME
FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.SITEID = O.SITEID AND L.PROCESSSEGMENTRULEID IS NULL
LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID
description: 지연 여부나 재작업 여부와 같은 복잡한 필터링 없이, 공정 세그먼트 규칙이 없는 LOT 중 상위 10 개를 제품명과 함께 조회합니다. JOIN 은 FK 관계만 따르며 불필요한 서브쿼리를 제거했습니다.

question: 지연 작업지시별 연결 LOT 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME, COUNT(L.LOTID) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTORDERID = L.PRODUCTORDERID AND O.SITEID = L.SITEID WHERE O.DELAYFLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME
pred_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCTORDERID, COUNT(L.LOTID) AS CONNECTED_LOT_COUNT FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER P WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL BR WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.PRODUCTORDERID = BR.PRODUCTORDERID AND P.SITEID = BR.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_LOTBATCHREL LBR WITH(NOLOCK) ON BR.BATCHID = LBR.BATCHID WHERE P.DELAYFLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY P.PRODUCTORDERID
description: 지연 작업지시 (DELAYFLAG='Y') 에 연결된 배치별 LOT 개수를 집계합니다. CIM_LOTBATCHREL 을 통해 PRODUCTORDER 와 LOT 를 간접적으로 연결하여 COUNT 합니다.

question: 불량률 상위 10개 LOT과 제품명을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.LOSSQTY, L.ORIGINALQTY, CASE WHEN L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 THEN CAST(L.LOSSQTY AS float) / L.ORIGINALQTY * 100 ELSE 0 END AS 불량률 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID WHERE L.ORIGINALQTY > 0 ORDER BY 불량률 DESC
pred_sql: SELECT TOP 10 L.LOTNAME, PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, CAST(L.DEFECTQTY AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / NULLIF(CAST(L.QTY AS FLOAT), 0) * 100.0 AS DEFECT_RATE FROM CIM_LOT L WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTORDERID = O.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = O.SITEID LEFT JOIN CIM_DEFECTCLASS D WITH(NOLOCK) ON L.DEFECTQTY > 0 JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON O.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = PD.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND O.SITEID = PD.SITEID WHERE L.QTY > 0 ORDER BY DEFECT_RATE DESC
description: 불량률 상위 10 개 LOT 와 제품명을 조회합니다. CIM_LOT, CIM_PRODUCTORDER, CIM_DEFECTCLASS, CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION 테이블을 JOIN 하여 계산하며, 스키마 제약사항 (WITH(NOLOCK) 위치, 별칭 규칙 등) 을 준수했습니다.
